title: Russia-Ukraine peace talks resume in Abu Dhabi, with Europe set to attend
caption:
Russia and Ukraine are due to resume US-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 November, with security guarantees expected to be the focus. France says European representatives will be there, while the Kremlin calls the meeting trilateral. Both sides carried out long-range strikes on the eve of the talks.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
